  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Finely chop the {{ing_01|white part of leeks}} and place in a sauce pan; add {{ing_02|oil}} (fry lightly) and {{ing_03|broth}}; next add {{ing_04|small sausage}} to be cooked likewise."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "To have a good Tarentine dish, they must be tender."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "The making of these sausage will be found among the Isicia (Nos. 60-66)."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Also make a sauce in the following manner: Crush {{ing_05|pepper}}, {{ing_06|lovage}} and {{ing_07|origany}}, moisten with {{ing_03|broth}}, add of the above ({{ing_04|sausage}}) gravy, {{ing_08|wine}}, {{ing_09|raisin wine}}; put in a sauce pan to be heated, when boiling, skim carefully, bind, sprinkle with {{ing_05|pepper}} and serve."
    }
  ],
